_comment: Version pin for the agent-device driver. This file is the single source of truth for which agent-device build this plugin is allowed to run. bin/mobile-qa-device reads it, resolves a matching binary, and refuses to run anything outside [minVersion, maxVersion]. Do not use @latest anywhere.
_nodeMin_comment: agent-device package.json declares engines.node >=22.12. npx does NOT enforce it, so a Node 20 host fails later and less clearly. bin/mobile-qa-device enforces the floor itself.
verifiedScope: CLI resolves and reports its version; --help and 'help doctor' render. Device-driving commands (open/snapshot/press/fill/doctor) were NOT executed during pinning.

knownBadVersions.0.20.4: packaging regression - the published npm tarball was broken. Fixed same day in 0.20.5. Never allow it.
knownBadVersions.<0.20.0: 0.20.0 removed gesture duration/velocity positionals and made ref frames expire after a mutation (ADR 0014). Skills and .ad scripts written for 0.20.x are not valid below it.

rollback: 1. Edit knownGoodVersion (and maxVersion) in this file to rollbackTo.
2. rm -rf "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}"/mobile-qa-device-resolve-* to drop the cached resolution.
3. mobile-qa-device --resolve   # confirm the reported version changed
4. If an MCP server entry is configured, update the pinned version in it too and restart the client.
